title: Accountant
description:
【Accountant】
Location：  Carson, CA
Responsibilities:

Responsible for logistic projects and product presentation financial planning process by preparing financial analysis and forecast modeling;  utilize  Excel and Oracle to analyze large   data sets; recommend future expense targets; plan and analyze business performance in partnership with cross-functional areas; communicate with IT and operation departments for specialized logistic requirements.
Perform SF Express infrastructure and expansion tax scenario planning analysis,  leveraging  a long-range business planning model to assess the potential impact of strategic portfolio decisions on the size, profitability, and returns of SF Express international operations over time.
Establish financial procedures according to  public traded companies' compliance requirements of financial reporting, custody and control of financial assets, financial  records, and loan  collateral management  to  ensure safekeeping;  determine  the scope of documentation necessary to support SF Express’ tax position.
Review financial records  submitted  by overseas countries, including revenue,  expenditure,  cycle turnover of account receivables, and discuss collection status and financial forecast  to  promote and  maintain  the financial stability of SF Express' operation in those overseas regions.
Review financial reports from the above offices. Prepare and  submit  the monthly  consolidated  financial results, budget, and rolling forecast to the Head of Finance and executive team. Design and enhance relevant financial and management account policies,  processes,  and SOP to support  SFExpress  business development globally.
Perform periodical and annual finalization of financial statements as per GAAP/IFRS with the relevant financial analysis to ensure reporting quality control and implementation of   financial improvement, work closely with the system development team to implement a financial consolidation system, set up accounting functions, complete U.S. data integration with global operation and provide necessary training to employees.
Review liquidity reports and forecasts from North Americas region offices, track SF Express Liquidity requirement and use of funds among offices, minimize financial and currency   exchange risks,  monitor  company financial situation according to  assessment of financial accounts and variance between actual accounts and budget, and predict each operation's financial returns and risks.
Research and analysis activities relating to profits and loss and potential adverse financial trends to monitor market movement,  identify  investment opportunities, and control financial risk (setting strategies to minimize  financial loss  or uncertainty).
Stay abreast of relevant government financial reporting and control guidelines, formulate financial strategies to maximize SF Express tax benefit plans, and provide tax advice for senior management's business strategies and investment decisions.
Provide audit support, assist in managing the identification and evaluation of the organization's audit risk areas, and audit financial information as needed to meet the needs of the group audit business team.

Qualifications:

Master's degree in Finance or Information Systems required;

Salary:  $79,000/Annual
Hours:  40 hours /week

title: Market Research Analyst
description:
【Market Research Analyst】
Location：  Springfield Garden, NY
Responsibilities:

Keeping pertinent data current used by market analysis and marketing strategy within S.F. Express's current business plan; aligning marketing strategies supported by the newest verifiable   market data within the corporate group and regional offices; conducting  additional  data collection on how shipping pricing, transition time, and customer spending point rewards will  impact  on   sales and market shares, compose an illustration of data graphically and  translation  complex findings into written text  pertaining  S.F. Express' operation.
Collecting information to plan for new location expansion and create new procedures to maximize daily efficiency; performing cost analyses, identifying new  trends  in the express delivery   services industry, assessing how it  impacts  the local submarkets where S.F. Express covers, and recommending  viable  modifications of existing strategies in aspects of pricing, advertising,   and other marketing campaigns,  i.e.  bonus Points scheme, Personal Shopper services, and Package Forwarding Services.
Cooperating with the sales department to develop new customers, provide solutions to major  logistics  projects and interconnectivity of equipment; making business initiatives including   creating new symbolic icons, drafting simple and concise messages on symbolic icons, matching new icons with upcoming promotion materials;  identifying  new business channels through   attending  industry related  trade shows and quarterly events, studying industry publications and related findings  to  the business reality of S.F. Express.
Evaluating client satisfaction by designing and conducting client surveys, opinion polls or questionnaires; properly interpreting survey results and comparing them with standards set out   within S.F. Express' existing service training manual to recommend procedure improvements.
Constantly  monitoring  and assessing the market challenges in the  logistics  industry, such as changes in market demands and transportation costs, and reporting impacts to S.F.   Express's management;  assisting  in coordinating cost collection for budget planning purposes including researching,  locating ,  evaluating,  and making initial contacts with potential fitting   shipping contractors/suppliers locally and internationally to maximize cost utilities within company’s budget constraints; acting as a liaison between shipping contractors/suppliers and   company management to  maintain  long-term relationships with stable shipping suppliers.
Collecting  viable  information on all existing competitors,  i.e.  FedEx, DHL, Dynamic Parcel Distribution, and UPS.; summarizing findings and updating the list of direct competitors to the   management and assessing competitive advantages and disadvantages of S.F. Express's business; recommending strategies in terms of pricing, featured services and market campaign   strategies.
Assisting  management in analyzing and proposing improvements on gateway (Brazil, Mexico,  Chile,  and Canada operations KPIs,  assisting  management in making decisions on   establishing new geographical service locations, suitable promotional activities, and marketing campaigns to each specific location.
Maintaining professional and technical knowledge by attending all operation training; choreographing and executing advertising and marketing programs; and sharing daily reports and tasks on the Enterprise Collaboration Platform on time.

Qualifications:

Master's degree in Finance or Business Administration required;
At least 6 months of experience as a Market Research Analyst is  required.

Salary:  $77,000/Annual
Hours:  40 hours /week
